summary: Iteration 6 retest PASSED. All three iteration-5 regressions are now fully fixed on the live preview. (1) Home title 'Let's learn something new' now computes fontWeight=600, maxWidth=260px and wraps cleanly onto two lines (width=260). (2) Home Balance card renders a LinearGradient(120deg, rgb(110,168,255) -> rgb(47,91,255) -> rgb(30,58,138)) — the blue brand gradient — with the translucent dark inner panel containing points-value (214 pts) and redeem-shortcut. (3) Wallet redeem tiles are now a horizontal ScrollView of four 266x220 large rounded tiles with all required testIDs (redeem-150, redeem-300, redeem-600, redeem-1200); each shows emoji, locked/unlocked badge, '+N minutes' title, points subtitle, and an in-card Redeem button. Regression checks: backend 34/34 pytest still pass; wallet has no theme-toggle testID (count=0); open-settings row navigates to /settings where settings-light, settings-dark and settings-back all function and dark/light toggle works; Discover, Practice, Social, Home tabs all navigate without red-screen errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning still present on web: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Also one warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (home grain overlay View). Functionality unaffected — carried over, can be batched into a style-migration task.

(Low priority, carry-over) Migrate shadow* style props to boxShadow and move pointerEvents from prop to style in home.tsx grain View to silence RNW deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Home pointsCard now correctly mounts <LinearGradient style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}> and the dotted grain overlay — dead-import smell from iter 5 is gone.
Wallet redeem tiles array is still inline in JSX (4 items). Fine now, but if a 5th tier is ever added, consider lifting to a REDEEM_TIERS module constant for discoverability.
server.py size not re-checked this iteration — splitting routers remains a non-blocking tech-debt item.

Current build mounts LinearGradient+grain overlay, renders the 4-tile horizontal redeem ScrollView with matching testIDs and dimensions, and sets title fontWeight:600 + maxWidth:260.
